data.title: Terra Tower
data.about:
Terra Tower, an exciting off-plan development by Dugasta Properties, is set to redefine modern living in the heart of Dubailand. This impressive residential project will rise 12 floors, offering a range of stylish studio 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments. Perfectly located just off Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street (D54), Terra Tower provides convenient access to major roadways like Dubai Al Ain Road (E66) and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311).

Designed with comfort and convenience in mind, Terra Tower will feature world-class amenities, including state-of-the-art gyms, recreational areas, a refreshing pool, and beautifully landscaped gardens. The development will also include a dedicated kids' play area, making it the perfect choice for families. With its prime location and exceptional facilities, Terra Tower offers an unparalleled lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most desirable neighborhoods.

characteristics_module.title: Terra Tower: Your Gateway to Urban Connectivity in Dubailand
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Panoramic views of Dubai’s skyline: Enjoy breathtaking vistas of Dubai’s iconic skyline from every apartment.
  • Unmatched Amenities: Access world-class amenities, including gyms, pools, gardens, and recreational areas.
  • Strategic Accessibility: Situated off Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street (D54), Terra Tower ensures seamless connectivity to Dubai's major highways.
  • Proximity to Attractions: Residents enjoy close proximity to premier leisure destinations such as IMG Worlds of Adventure and Dubai Outlet Mall.
  • Comprehensive Urban Living: The location provides easy access to essential services, educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and a variety of dining and retail options, ensuring a convenient and fulfilling lifestyle within a vibrant community.

location_tile.title: Live in Dubailand with Unbeatable Connectivity & Convenience
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Situated in the heart of Dubailand, Terra Tower benefits from a vibrant community known for its family-friendly environment and dynamic lifestyle offerings. Dubailand is home to world-class attractions like IMG Worlds of Adventure and Dubai Outlet Mall, ensuring endless leisure and entertainment options. With expansive green spaces, recreational facilities, and proximity to major landmarks, Dubailand is a sought-after destination for modern living.

  • 10 Minutes - Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311)
  • 8 Minutes - Silicon Central Mall
  • 11 Minutes - IMG Worlds of Adventure
  • 20 Minutes - Dubai International Airport
